breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification says 'Use Strang splitting method with explicit forward Euler time integration,' which combines both conflicting instructions rather than resolving the conflict. The ground truth removes the 'Explicit forward Euler' reference entirely, as the Strang splitting method uses exact solvers (Fourier-space exact diffusion and exact logistic ODE). The agent failed to drop the erroneous forward Euler instruction.
